polaris.question: Hi Lumi, it's the start of November 2026.  This month's big sale is the 11.11 mega sale. What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.

The 11.11 mega sale drives high traffic, especially on marketplaces like Shopee and TikTok Shop—where you’re losing 9–14% in fees—and your tailored blazer is currently out of stock, missing weekly profit of ~MYR 229. Focus on capturing demand while protecting margins.

1. Restock the tailored blazer immediately using Polaris’s plan: order **11 units** (cost MYR 1,012) from your local tailor so inventory arrives before 11 Nov; this could recover ~MYR 229/week in lost profit once live.  
2. Run a **limited-time bundle** on your website (lowest fee: 2.9% + MYR 1/order): pair the satin wrap dress (MYR 139) with silk-touch scarf (MYR 39) at MYR 158 total—a MYR 20 discount vs buying separately. Based on your 32 dress and 20 scarf sales last month, even a 25% uptake could add ~MYR 160 profit after fees.

With your current ad efficiency, this could drive ~15–25 extra sales, adding ~MYR 800–1,200 gross before fees—monitor ROAS closely to keep net positive.  

Track daily sales and ad spend in a simple sheet (mission: Set up simple bookkeeping) to see what’s working. Avoid deep discounts—they erode your premium-feel pricing. Stick to bundles and limited urgency. Good luck for 11.11! 🌟

With strong November sales but significant stock‑outs, improving inventory flow will unlock immediate profit while keeping ad spend efficient.

1. Execute the exact restock plan from today’s Stock page: order 29 Silk‑touch scarves (MYR 348), 50 Satin wrap dresses (MYR 2,600), 45 Linen co‑ord sets (MYR 2,970), and 15 Tailored blazers (MYR 1,380). Total cost = MYR 7,298 – well within cash reserves and designed to cover expected demand plus the 12.12 lift.
2. Shift ad budget toward retargeting: allocate ~MYR 600 of the MYR 2,400 monthly ads to Shopee and TikTok dynamic product ads showing the four restocked items to users who viewed but didn’t buy (based on 86 TikTok Live peak viewers and 41 influencer‑code orders). Test creatives highlighting “back in stock” and limited‑time 12.12 pricing; expect ~15‑25 additional conversions weekly at a lower cost per order than broad prospecting.
3. Open pre‑orders for the 12.12 sale on your website and Instagram: offer a 10 % discount on bundles (e.g., satin dress + silk scarf) with a clear cutoff of 5 Dec for production. Capture deposits now to lock in sales, reduce post‑sale stock‑out risk, and improve cash flow before the big day. Aim for 30‑40 pre‑orders (≈MYR 4,200–5,600 revenue) based on November’s 135‑order volume and the known demand gaps.

polaris.question: Hi Lumi, it's the start of January 2027. Last month: 2026-12: sales MYR 15k from 148 orders (118 new, 30 repeat), average order MYR 104. About 3 orders lost to stock-outs or packing limits. Ran out of: Tailored blazer (1 more wanted). Stock left: 61 pieces worth MYR 2,152 at cost (bought 139). Ads MYR 2,400, about MYR 64 per order from ads. Platform fees MYR 1,248. Costs MYR 15k, net MYR 682. Cash now MYR 20k. Shop rating 4.54. This month's big sale is the 1.1 New Year sale. What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.
polaris.advice:
FINANCE  

Your December data shows strong turnover but thin margins—ads ate ~16 % of revenue while only three stock‑outs cost you potential sales. To lift profit this month, tighten ad efficiency, eliminate avoidable stock‑outs, and push higher‑margin channels before the 1.1 New Year sale rush.

1. **Audit and trim ad spend**: Pull the last 30‑day ad report from Shopee/TikTok. Pause any creative or audience with ROAS below 2.0 (i.e., earning less than MYR 2 per MYR 1 spent). Reallocate the saved MYR 400–600 to boost high‑margin organic posts (e.g., TikTok Live try‑ons) and retarget website visitors with a MYR 50‑off bundle code. Expect to shave MYR 0.5–0.8 off the MYR 64/ad‑order cost, adding roughly MYR 200–300 extra net profit if sales hold steady.

2. **Lock in blazer stock NOW**: Your restock plan calls for 21 Tailored blazers (MYR 1,932). Place that order today with your KL tailor so it arrives before the 1.1 sale. Each blazer sold via Instagram/WhatsApp or your site nets ~MYR 109 after fees; even selling just 12 of the 21 during the sale week would add ~MYR 1,300 profit and prevent the MYR 441/week missed‑sale loss you saw in December.

3. **Shift 20 % of December’s Shopee/TikTok volume to the website**: Website orders keep 97.1 % of revenue (only MYR 1/order + 2.9 % fee) vs. Shopee’s 86 % and TikTok’s 91 %. Use your existing Instagram following to post a “Website‑only New Year bundle” (satin dress + silk scarf) priced at MYR 150 (cost MYR 64). Target the 30 repeat buyers from December with a personal DM offering free shipping. Converting just 6 of those repeats adds ~MYR 516 profit (6 × MYR 86 net) and begins building your owned‑audience channel for higher long‑term margin.  

Track daily ad ROAS, blazer stock levels, and website order share; adjust weekly to stay on track for MYR 8,800 monthly sales needed for Level 4. 🌟

polaris.advice:
Last month’s strong February shows healthy demand but stock‑outs limited upside—you turned away ~13 orders worth roughly MYR 1,456 in potential revenue (based on avg order value). Your cash buffer lets you act fast. Focus on securing inventory for the Raya last‑call sale while tightening ad efficiency and shifting repeat buyers to lower‑fee channels.

1. **Execute the restock plan today**: Order exactly 29 Silk‑touch scarves (MYR 348), 64 Satin wrap dresses (MYR 3,328), 26 Linen co‑ord sets (MYR 1,716) and 20 Tailored blazers (MYR 1,840) – totalling MYR 7,232. These quantities match your Polaris restock plan and will cover projected Raya demand plus a safety buffer. Receive goods within 5–7 days to avoid missing the 10 Mar Raya window.

2. **Cut ad waste by improving targeting**: Your February ads cost MYR 800 for ~18 attributed orders (MYR 45/order). Pause broad campaigns and re‑allocate MYR 400 to retarget website visitors who viewed product pages but didn’t buy (use Shopee/TikTok pixel data). Test look‑alike audiences based on your 47 repeat buyers. Expect to maintain similar order volume at ~MYR 30/ad order, saving ~MYR 200‑300 this month.

3. **Push repeat buyers to your website**: You have 47 repeat customers from February. Send a personalized WhatsApp broadcast offering free shipping + a MYR 10 loyalty voucher on orders placed via your site (fees drop from avg 9% to 2.9% + MYR 1/order). For a typical MYR 112 order, that saves ~MYR 9 in fees per order. If 20 repeats shift, you keep ~MYR 180 extra profit this month with minimal effort. Track uptake via unique discount code “WEBLOYAL”.
